summary: Vulcan Infrastructure & Power Inc., formerly Greenidge Generation Holdings, filed an 8-K reporting completion of its redemption of all $30,345,200 aggregate principal amount of 8.50% Senior Notes due 2026 at par plus accrued interest, totaling roughly $30,868,233, on the October 13, 2026 redemption date. Interest ceased accruing; no notes remain outstanding. Nasdaq filed a Form 25 to delist and deregister the notes, effective on or about October 23, 2026 and January 12, 2027 respectively. Class A common stock remains listed under VIP. Watch for deleveraging effects on the capital structure and any follow-on refinancing.
